name: singlet_genetics_cell_type_cis_eqtl_mapping
title: Cell-type cis-eQTL mapping and cross-cell-type sharing
description: Maps common variants in each gene's cis window to donor-level expression within each cell type, with permutation-calibrated gene-level q-values, then shares effects across cell types with mashr. Needs donor genotypes and donor-by-cell-type structure in the dataset. Do not use for cell-state interaction effects (use genetics.context_dependent_eqtl) or for cell-level mixed models, which are benchmark comparators only.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with donor genotypes in uns/genotype_dosage.

model.description: Test family; the donor-level linear model is the only model in this version.

cis_scan.description: Cis window and variant filter shared by all models.

window.description: Cis window half-width around the TSS, in bases.

maf_threshold.description: Minimum minor allele frequency of tested variants.

covariates.description: Donor covariates from uns/donor_covariates; add cell_type_proportions if composition may depend on genotype.

obs_keys.description: Names of the obs columns for donor, cell type and batch.

min_donors_per_celltype.description: Skip cell types with fewer donors; null disables the gate. Set from a power analysis.

pseudobulk_linear.description: Options for the donor-level linear model.

beta_approx.description: Fit the beta approximation to the permutation maxima.

fdr.description: FDR target for gene-level q-values, per cell type.

min_cells_per_donor_celltype.description: Minimum cells needed to form a donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk.

enabled.description: Apply sharing when at least two cell types have results.

lfsr_threshold.description: Local false sign rate cut-off for sharing calls.

covariances.description: Covariance grid for the mashr prior.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing results.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: computed inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/cis_eqtl/<cell_type>. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Per cell type: n_donors, n_pairs_tested, n_egenes_q05, lambda_gc, skipped flag; mashr: n_shared and n_specific calls at lfsr_threshold. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
